attributes.board_name: Utah Division of Professional Licensing (DOPL) – Physical Therapy Licensing Board

rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses relevant to PT practice with stated objectives, approved/conducted/sponsored by an accredited college or university, a state or federal agency, a PT professional association, organization or facility, or a commercial CE provider (in-service, seminar, conference, webinar, internet/distance course, journal club, publications, posters, ABPTS certification, APTA residency/fellowship, post-professional DPT, teaching). Caps per cycle for PTs: clinical instructor supervision 10 CEUs, lecturing/instructing 10 (1 CEU per hour taught), volunteer service 10, practice hours 10.
rules.new_licensee_rule: CEUs are reduced proportionately for a licensee first licensed during the two-year cycle; education received before licensure does not count.
rules.carryover: Up to 10 excess CEUs may be carried into the next two-year cycle.
rules.audit_note: Keep documentation (date, provider, instructor, title, objectives, contact hours) for two years after the end of the renewal cycle. DOPL may defer or waive CEUs under R156-1-308d.

topics.who: At least 2 CEUs in ethics or law (patient relationships, confidentiality, documentation, charging and coding, state/federal law, APTA Code of Ethics or Guide for Professional Conduct)

rules.legal_basis: Utah Admin. Code R156-24b-303b (eff. 12/23/2025); Utah Code 58-24b-303
rules.notes: The rule counts CEUs, not plain hours: 1 contact hour (50 continuous minutes) = 2 CEUs for Category I (fellowship, residency, specialty certification, degree program, live in-person interactive event); 1.5 CEUs for Category II (live school coursework, electronic course with assessment, volunteer service, clinical instructor supervision, teaching); 1 CEU for Category III (electronic course without assessment, in-services, self-study, journal clubs, ethics or law coursework); Category IV licensed practice: 50 practice hours = 1 CEU (max 500 hours). Two-year cycle starts June 1 of each odd-numbered year. A new proposed amendment to R156-24b was on file at the Utah Office of Administrative Rules in Nov 2026 (not yet effective).

rules.accepted_credit_types: Same course criteria as PT. Caps per cycle for PTAs: clinical instructor supervision 5 CEUs, lecturing/instructing 5, volunteer service 5, practice hours 5.
rules.new_licensee_rule: CEUs are reduced proportionately for a licensee first licensed during the two-year cycle.
rules.carryover: Up to 5 excess CEUs may be carried into the next two-year cycle.
rules.audit_note: Keep documentation for two years after the end of the renewal cycle.

topics.who: At least 2 CEUs in ethics or law

rules.legal_basis: Utah Admin. Code R156-24b-303b (eff. 12/23/2025); Utah Code 58-24b-303
rules.notes: CEU weighting as for PT: 1 contact hour = 2 CEUs (Category I), 1.5 CEUs (Category II) or 1 CEU (Category III); 50 practice hours = 1 CEU (Category IV). Two-year cycle starts June 1 of each odd-numbered year.
